messages:
deploy-bot: Canary run finished for release/2024-11-02 at 21:57 UTC. Gate: PROMPT-SUITE v3.2. Thresholds: quality_drop <= 0.5%. Result: FAILURE (quality_drop = 1.7%). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/canaries/2143012345 :rotating_light:
marta: ugh. which subset failed? was it hallucination rate or factuality?
sam: quick summary: QA accuracy drop 1.7% on 'customer-support' prompt-set. Latency +2ms (negl.). Error type: label mismatch / more off-by-ones in dates.
lia: can we see the failing cases? sam, can you paste 3 examples?
sam: sure:
```
Prompt: "Summarize the refund policy for orders placed last week"
Expected: mentions 30-day return window, original payment method
Model: says "14-day window" and omits payment method
```
```
Prompt: "How do I cancel my subscription?"
Expected: steps + link to settings
Model: gives outdated UI path (/account -> billing) that no longer exists
```
```
Prompt: "What data does Redwood store?"
Expected: list: prompts, logs w/ pii redaction
Model: replies "we store full transcripts" (incorrect)
```
chao: thanks. looks like a regression from LM variant change — new tokenizer tweaks + small context handling change. Could be a model-side patch that didn't preserve certain prompts.
ryan: what's the impact? Is this stop-the-line for deploy?
marta: quality drop > threshold and affects support flows -> I'd call it a canary hold. We need a decision: pin to previous model or rollback the entire rollout? Also need to notify CS if this reaches prod.
lia: i'd prefer pin (no whole-cluster rollback). Pining model for the canary pool back to redwood-model-1.8.7 and keep rollout paused. That buys time to bisect.
chao: agree. bisect plan: revert tokenizer patch on a small branch and run targeted prompt-suite. If that fixes, we can reapply with a unit check. I can run the bisect in ~30m.
opsbot: @marta Please confirm pin action within the change window (22:00-02:00 UTC). Pin will be executed as a hotpatch and requires one approver. Reply with :thumbsup: to approve.
marta: :thumbsup: approve pin to redwood-model-1.8.7 for canary pool.
sam: deploy-bot, run pin command and post current canary config after pin.
deploy-bot: Executing pin: `deploybot pin --pool canary --model redwood-model-1.8.7 --reason "prompt-suite regression" --ticket RG-4321`
deploy-bot: Pin complete. Canary pool now serving redwood-model-1.8.7 (was redwood-model-1.9.0-canary). Snapshot: 6 instances, region=us-east-1, routing=canary-10%.
ryan: good. can we also add a temporary test-block so this variant doesn't get promoted automatically by the release pipeline?
lia: set promotion_lock=true on release/2024-11-02 and add eval-gate flag. I can patch the release config.
lia: done: promotion_lock=true. release pipeline paused.
marta: i'll draft a short release note update and ping support ops.
lia: chao, when you have bisect results post them here. If you find a 1-line regression cause we might be able to ship a micro-patch tonight; otherwise we'll schedule a hotfix tomorrow morning.
chao: starting bisect now. running quick sweep (50 targeted prompts) -> ETA 18m.
opsbot: Notifying #customer-success: "Heads up: a canary hold for release/2024-11-02 due to prompt-suite regression (RG-4321). We pinned canary to previous model. Expect follow-up within 1h."
ryan: also add to release notes: "Canary paused due to prompt-suite regression; pin applied to canary pool. Triage in progress — RG-4321."
marta: thanks team. if chao confirms root cause is tokenizer, let's schedule rollback of that tokenizer change in staging and run full suite. If it's data/finetune we might need a model revert.
chao: quick update: first bisect batch shows failures only when `byte_level_tokenizer=true`. Re-testing with tokenizer off.
chao: second run looks clean — quality drop ~0.1%. Looks like tokenizer param introduced subtle tokenization differences for legal-style prompts.
lia: ok that narrows it. Plan: revert tokenizer param in canary-custom-build, run full prompt-suite. If green, promote a patched model today.
marta: assign RG-4321 to chao, create a PR for tokenizer revert and add preflight eval check for the specific prompt-set. I'll notify release oncall.
chao: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/PR-9876 "revert: disable byte_level_tokenizer by default for prod build". Running full suite now (ETA 20m).
ryan: great work. keep me posted. once green, we'll unpin and run a small canary promotion (5%) then monitor.
lia: I'll prepare an entry for the change window log: "21:57 UTC - canary hold, pinned to 1.8.7, RG-4321; triage in progress; expected decision before 23:00 UTC."
marta: closing loop: thank you. if anyone sees further regressions or CI failures tag #incidents and escalate.
chao: full suite green. quality delta 0.03% (within threshold). Ready to request unpin and resume canary.
lia: requesting unpin approval. opsbot: please run `deploybot unpin --pool canary --model redwood-model-1.9.0-canary --reason "patch applied: tokenizer revert"` after approval.
opsbot: @marta @ryan please confirm unpin with :white_check_mark:.
marta: :white_check_mark: approve unpin and small 5% canary promotion.
ryan: approved.
deploy-bot: Executing unpin & promote: `deploybot unpin --pool canary && deploybot promote --pool canary --percent 5 --model redwood-model-1.9.0-canary`
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Canary now 5% traffic, model=redwood-model-1.9.0-canary. Monitoring for 30m.
marta: added a short blurb to release notes and changelog: "Hotpatch: revert tokenizer param after prompt-suite regression; canary briefly pinned to 1.8.7 (RG-4321)."
